About Me
Artificial Intelligence and Data Science undergraduate at Mepco Schlenk Engineering College with strong
interest in software development, data analytics, and problem solving. Experienced in building practical
applications using Python and web technologies, with exposure to machine learning and data visualization
tools. Enthusiastic learner who actively participates in hackathons and technical events to improve technical
and collaborative skills.
Education
-Bachelor of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science 2023-2027
Mepco Schlenk Engineering College, Sivakasi CGPA: 8.34
-Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) 2023
St. Madonnas Higher Secondary School, Kalugumalai Percentage: 88.9%
Projects
-Secure File Sharing System | GitHub 2025
Client-server based secure file sharing platform
- Developed a centralized server allowing multiple clients to securely upload and download files.
- Implemented TCP, HTTP, and SFTP protocols for reliable communication.
- Added authentication mechanisms to restrict unauthorized file access.
-Video Summary Generator | GitHub 2025
AI based application for generating summaries from video content
- Developed a system that extracts key information from videos and converts it into concise text summaries.
- Applied Natural Language Processing techniques to analyze and summarize video transcripts.
- Built a simple interface that allows users to upload videos and automatically generate summaries.
-Maze Solver | GitHub 2025
Algorithm based application for solving maze pathfinding problems
- Developed a maze solving application using pathfinding algorithms to determine the shortest route.
- Implemented algorithms such as Depth First Search (DFS) and Breadth First Search (BFS) to navigate maze
structures.
- Visualized the path traversal process and optimal route from start to destination.
-Hospital Finder using GPS Location | GitHub 2025
Application that locates nearby hospitals using GPS location data
- Implemented location-based search to display nearby hospitals with ratings and distance.
- Integrated OpenStreetMap API for real-time location mapping.
- Designed a simple interface for quick access to emergency healthcare facilities.
Technical Skills
Programming Languages: C, Python, Java
Concepts: Data Structures, Computer Networks,Operating Systems,OOPS
